title: Monotonicity of the mean
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ and $g$ map the sign cube to the two signs. If $f(x)\le g(x)$ for every input $x$, then the mean of their real-valued sign representations satisfies $\mathbb E[f]\le\mathbb E[g]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ map the sign cube to the two signs
